name: Daraxt
tagline: Eco furniture in solid wood with no lacquer, formaldehyde glue or plastic

seo.title: Daraxt — eco furniture in solid wood in Tashkent
seo.description: Beds, tables and shelves in solid elm, walnut and pine. No lacquer — only oil and wax, no chipboard or formaldehyde glue. Made in 14 days and up.
seo.answer: Daraxt is an eco furniture workshop in Tashkent (Shaykhantakhur, 8 Labzak Street). It makes beds, tables and shelving in solid elm, walnut and pine finished with oil and wax, with no chipboard or lacquer. A pine bed starts at UZS 4,200,000, an elm table at UZS 5,600,000, made in 14 days and up.

listing.description: A site for an eco furniture workshop or natural-materials brand: warm paper, a priced solid-wood catalogue, figures about materials, an ordering path with delivery and a gallery.

sections.title: Furniture you can breathe around
sections.eyebrow: Solid wood · oil and wax · no lacquer
sections.subtitle: We build from solid boards, not chipboard panels: elm, walnut and pine finished with oil and wax. Your bedroom smells of wood, not glue.

sections.label: Workshop
sections.title: Timber that has lived its own life
sections.text: We source elm and walnut from planned orchard clearing in Tashkent region, dry it for six months under cover and only then start work. Joints are pinned rather than screwed, finished with linseed oil and beeswax — a scratch can be sanded out at home in five minutes.

items.title: “Dastarkhan” dining table
items.text: A three-board top with a live edge.

items.title: “Shelf” bookcase
items.text: Open back so the wood can breathe.

items.title: Choosing the wood
items.text: We show you the actual boards so you can choose the grain.

items.title: Drawing
items.text: We fit the dimensions to your room and fix the price.

items.title: Making
items.text: From 14 days: planing, joining, three coats of oil.

items.title: Delivery
items.text: We deliver and assemble, free within Tashkent.

items.quote: Our child has allergies; with the new bed there’s finally no chemical smell.
items.author: Gulnora

items.quote: We chose the boards for our table ourselves; the elm grain looks like a painting.
items.author: Sherzod

items.a: Oil soaks into the wood and doesn’t crack. The furniture feels good to the touch and scratches are easy to refresh.
We dry it for six months and leave room for seasonal movement — joints carry a 5-year warranty.

items.q: How do I look after it?
items.a: Once a year, wipe it with the oil from the kit we leave with the furniture.

items.q: Do you deliver to the regions?

sections.text: The Labzak workshop is open Mon–Sat 9–18. Tell us on Telegram what you’d like and we will send photos of the timber we have.
